excludedClasses: Raw native capture dumps and root tool dumps
Protected opaque tokens, reasoning, and private messages
Unrelated browser tabs, app inventory, private URLs, account data, and credentials
Screenshots not visually reviewed for task-only pixels
Environment maps and broad completion or source-manifest dumps
policy: A pattern scan alone does not authorize publication. Only the inspected case-scoped field, command-event, result-prefix, and fixture-source selections are proposed. No protected payload is decoded.

omittedArtifacts.reason: Only a narrow inspected projection may be included. Private original remains unchanged.
